Hi Elena — thanks for the note. Welcome — excited to get this moving. Attached are the items that will cover your questions: redwood_ap-onboarding_packet.pdf (overview + examples) and redwood_vendor_form.xlsx (vendor registration + bank remittance).

Quick answers up front:
- Legal name (for supplier record): Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EU VAT: Redwood Inference EU VAT ID: EU123456789 (we've attached our VAT certificate copy in the packet).
- Preferred remit currency: EUR accepted; invoices can be billed in EUR or USD. Please include currency on each invoice.
- Bank remit: IBAN and SWIFT should be provided on the vendor form (we will return a signed W-8 / tax cert if required for non-EU entities).
- PO handling: we can accept POs that start with your JP- prefix. We require the PO number to be visible on the invoice header and as the invoice filename (see naming convention below). Line-level GL codes are optional; we can map when you provide a PO with line descriptions.
- E-invoicing: we support PDF by email to ap@redwood.ai and can accept UBL/PEPPOL push if you provide your endpoint; otherwise PDF is fine.

Required invoice rules (please incorporate into JupiterPay's vendor record):
1) Filename convention: JP-<PONumber>_<InvoiceDate>_RedwoodInference.pdf  (example: JP-000123_20260901_RedwoodInference.pdf)
2) PO number: must appear on first page and in the invoice metadata when sending via SFTP/EDI.
3) Invoice layout: subtotal, VAT amount, VAT rate, total. For reverse-charge invoices mark VAT = 0 and include a note: "Reverse charge: Article 194" or local equivalent.
4) Remit details: IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, Beneficiary legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), bank address (provided in vendor form).
5) Payment terms: default Net 60 for enterprise customers (we can do Net 30 for pilot customers; see note below).

Actions requested from JupiterPay to complete your vendor record:
- Complete and return redwood_vendor_form.xlsx with bank remittance, VAT registration document, and supplier contact.
- Confirm whether you'll push invoices to a PEPPOL endpoint or prefer ap@redwood.ai PDF.
- Provide a sample PO (JP- prefixed) so we can validate parsing.

I copied Rachel (payments integration) to give the PO->GL mapping specifics and Marissa (finance) on terms and onboarding SLA. Let me know if you'd like a 20-minute screen share this week.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Hi Elena — looping back with the integration/mapping notes from our side (so your procurement team can drop these straight into their vendor template):

Required PO/Invoice header fields our parser checks:
- BuyerLegalEntity (string) -> must match "JupiterPay Ltd" or your configured buyer code
- PONumber (string) -> supports prefix JP- and free text.
- PODate (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Currency (ISO 4217)
- InvoiceAmountGross (decimal)
- VATAmount (decimal)
- VATRate (percentage or 0 for reverse-charge)
- ReverseChargeFlag (boolean or yes/no) -> if true we will set VATAmount = 0 and require "Reverse charge: [local statute]" text in the invoice body.
- RemitAccount (string) -> IBAN or internal remit code
- SupplierLegalName (string) -> must match vendor record (Redwood Inference, Inc.)

Mapping notes:
- Header-only POs are supported: if no line-level GL codes are present we map lines into a generic "Consulting / Software" ledger account unless you provide a mapping file.
- If you want PO -> GL determinism, include PO line's "account_code" or provide a one-time mapping CSV.
- E-invoice: we accept PEPPOL/UBL (channel handshake required). If you plan to send via PEPPOL, please share your SMP/SML identifier or our team will provide a receiver ID.

AP email and filters: please send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai (we whitelist inbound domains). For your self-billing question — Redwood Finance can engage but we prefer supplier-created invoices for audit traceability. We'll evaluate a self-billing pilot (requires a signed self-billing agreement).

I'll attach a small sample PO->invoice mapping (po-sample.xml) and a CSV with the default ledger mapping we use for header-only POs.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Payments Integration Lead
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai
